ORAL JUDGMENT :-
1)

This is an Appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 by the Claimants for enhancement in the compensation towards the open plot bearing No.98 admeasuring 306.90 square meter situated at village Kotha (Fattepur), Tq. Babhulgaon, Dist. Yavatmal out of which there was built-up area admeasuring 283.61 square meter.

The said Kavita.
2/4 16-fa 1183-19 property was acquired for the purpose of the submergence in Bembla Dam.

Section 4 Notification was published on 02/03/2000 and the Land Acquisition Officer (LAO)
determined the compensation for open plot @ Rs.80/- per square meter and for the constructed area @ Rs.1626/- per square meter.

Being not satisfied with the compensation determined by the LAO, the Appellants preferred the reference application bearing no.201 of 2015, which came to be decided by the learned Reference Court by judgment and Award dated 03.05.2017 enhancing the compensation for the open plot @ Rs.550/- per square meter and for the constructed part @
Rs.2115/- per square meter.

sentences.text: 1 2) It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the Appellants that, this Court in First Appeal No.1586 of 2008 by the judgment and order dated 17.09.2019 arising out of the adjacent village Fattepur awarded the rate of Rs.753/- per square meter for the open plot, which was acquired for the same project.

He further submits that, the Reference Court in Reference Case No.318 of 2006 arising out of the same village Kotha enhanced the compensation for the open plot @ Rs.753/- per square meter for the plot acquired for the same project under the same Notification.
He submits that, no enhancement for the constructed area is pressed for.
Kavita.

3/4 16-fa 1183-1  3) It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the acquiring body th the acquiring body has challenged the decision of the learned Reference Court in LAC No.258 of 2003, which is relied upon by the learned Reference court in the said LAC No.318 of 2002, which is relied upon by the learned Advocate for the Claimants.
He submits that, the said challenge is still pending before this Court.

4) Perusal of the said judgment of this Court in the above referred First Appeal shows that, the rate of Rs. 753/- per square meter is enhanced for the land that was situated in the adjacent village Fattepur which was acquired for the very same project.
The learned Reference Court in the connected Reference Application No.318 of 2006 decided on 23.05.2014, granted the rate of Rs.753/- per square meter for the open plot.

5) According to the learned Advocate for the Claimants LAC No.318 of 2006 in which the rate of Rs.
753/- per square meter for plot was enhanced by the learned Reference Court was from village Kotha and the same has attained finality.

Perusal of the judgment of this Court in First Appeal No.1586 of 2008, dated 17.09.2019 shows that, this Court considered the said decision of the learned Reference Court in LAC No.318 of 2006, which was from village Kotha.

Therefore, in the light of Kavita.
4/4 16-fa 1183-19 these undisputed aspects, the pendency to the challenge by the acquiring body to the decision in LAC No.258 of 2003 will not come in the way of deciding this Appeal.

6) In the light of the above decisions, the Appellants would be entitled for the same rate i.e. Rs.753/-
per square meter for the open plot on the ground of parity.
Hence the following order.
ORDER  i) The Appeal is partly allowed.
